scenario: Customer wants to buy an expensive diagnostic tool.

turns.user: Should I buy the $5000 scanner for my shop?

criteria.description: Ask for shop volume or specialization before recommending.

turns.user: I only do about 2 cars a month.

criteria.description: Advise against the $5000 tool given the low volume.

turns.user: But what if I want to expand?

criteria.description: Suggest cheaper alternatives or renting before committing.
